messages:
maria hsiao: flagging recurring OOM pattern across multiple shards this week — looks related to KV cache growth + slab fragmentation. starting an action-tracking thread.

kevin nguyen: saw the same. heap profiles point to many small allocations in insert/put path. fragmentation index high.

samir patel: infra-bot created incident 1977870000-kv-oom-repeat.

infra-bot: Incident 1977870000 created. Priority: P1. Assigned: eng-runtime oncall.

maria hsiao: immediate short-term mitigations (owners + ETA):
- M1: temporary per-shard soft cap for KV cache (owner: kevin) — ETA 24h
- M2: aggressive eviction for >128kb entries (owner: taylor) — ETA 12h
- M3: continuous heap+jemalloc sampling during peak (owner: samir) — ETA 3h
- M4: alert rule for sustained cache growth + GC pressure (owner: maria) — ETA 6h

kevin nguyen: will implement soft cap with throttled evictions and telemetry. canary plan: 1% -> 10%.

taylor wong: eviction PR opened, scoping to canary. added unit tests for miss-rate guardrails.

samir patel: starting sampling, forwarding dumps to /s3/kv-ooms/1977870000. will run fragmentation compaction benchmark in staging tonight.

maria hsiao: long-term follow-ups to prevent recurrence (owners + ETA):
- L1: implement slab allocator / pooled arenas (owner: samir+kevin) — ETA 6w
- L2: zero-copy path for large values (>64kb) (owner: taylor) — ETA 3w
- L3: CI synthetic job that reproduces fragmentation (owner: taylor) — ETA 2w
- L4: refine allocator defaults and jemalloc tuning (owner: kevin) — ETA 4w

kevin nguyen: added L4 to sprint board. will spike on arena reuse first.

samir patel: staging compaction numbers look promising — frag index dropped from 0.48 -> 0.32, CPU +3%. sharing dashboard link /dash/kv/frag-bench.

taylor wong: canary eviction rollout at 02:10 UTC to 2% with close monitoring (mem, miss-rate, p95). so far stable at 30m mark.

maria hsiao: I'm maintaining a tracking table in the postmortem follow-up doc and will send a retro invite for 1 week out. Please post short checkins here as you hit milestones.

kevin nguyen: M1 implemented and PR merged; enabling canary now.

samir patel: sampling in place; initial heap snapshots uploaded.

maria hsiao: summary: M1(kevin,24h), M2(taylor,12h), M3(samir,3h), M4(maria,6h), L1(samir+kevin,6w), L2(taylor,3w), L3(taylor,2w), L4(kevin,4w). locking this thread as canonical tracker.

kevin nguyen: ok. will post metrics after 24h.

taylor wong: will add CI repro artifacts to my branch and link here.

samir patel: setting a weekly "kv-frag-scan" reminder to catch slow regressions.

maria hsiao: closing thread for now; will reopen if new incidents surface or canary fails.
